description: BMS control-network device (switch, router or gateway) in the Network Topology view. A failed device stops forwarding, so every point behind it goes Bad (review A11).
name: Control-network device

role.description: What the device is on the control network: `device` (switch, server, workstation) or `gateway` (where field data reaches Ignition; a point is fresh only while a path exists from its asset to a gateway).

serves.description: For a gateway: comma-separated Asset systems (`Cooling, Airside`) whose equipment reports through it when the equipment has no net connection of its own (plant design `gateways`).
